text: Kimi Antonelli is the 2026 Formula 1 world champion. On Sunday, the 20-year-old Mercedes driver finished third at the Mexico City Grand Prix, which was enough to seal the title while Max Verstappen won the race. He's now the youngest champion in the sport's history, in only his second season. It also ends a long wait for Italy, i.e. its first world champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
